text: Healthy living means taking care of your body and mind. First, eat a balanced diet with plenty of fruit, vegetables, and whole grains, and avoid too much sugar and fast food. Second, exercise regularly—even a thirty-minute walk every day makes a big difference. Getting enough sleep is also important, so try to go to bed at the same time each night. Don't forget mental health: talk to friends and family when you feel stressed. Finally, keep a good work-life balance by making time for rest and hobbies. Small daily habits like these can help you feel healthier and happier in the long term.
